LESSON: PRINT AWARENESS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: READING
Topic 2.1: Print awareness
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Print awareness, part of READING in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: Why do you enjoy reading certain pictures?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Print awareness together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
• Respect: The learner with other learners take turns in talking about pictures related to school.

• Unity: The learners work together in talking about the pictures.

SECTION 6: SUMMARY

Main points to remember:


Remember the key question: Why do you enjoy reading certain pictures?

Core Competencies:

• Communication and communication: The learner with others read pictures and picture stories collaboratively.

Self-efficacy: The learner correctly identifies pictures and is appreciated by others.

• Respect: The learner with other learners take turns in talking about pictures related to school.

• Unity: The learners work together in talking about the pictures.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issue(

Link to other Activity Areas:

Environmental Activities as the learner reads pictures of different things found within the school environment.
